purpose: Compile one desired runner-class policy into root, controller, executor, and validation projections without carrying live activation/quarantine state inside the static policy catalog.

source_evidence: exact trusted workflow files from owning repositories at declared default-branch checkpoints
repository registry and project isolation roots/identities

canonicalization.format: UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively sorted object keys and compact separators for digest input
canonicalization.catalog_generation_id: sha256 over canonical desired-policy inputs plus exact source workflow blob identities
canonicalization.projection_rule: every generated root/controller/executor projection carries the same catalog_generation_sha256
canonicalization.semantic_immutability: existing runner_class_id may not change its fully resolved root launch envelope between generations
canonicalization.control_plane_generation_sha256: hash of all canonical static desired-policy inputs plus frozen workflow evidence; changes for any policy/evidence change
canonicalization.root_policy_sha256: hash only of root host-resource policy plus resolved runner-class launch envelopes; ingress/workflow command-only changes MUST NOT change it
canonicalization.root_envelope_sha256: hash of one immutable runner-class launch envelope excluding overall generation identity; capability change requires a new runner_class_id
canonicalization.controller_policy_sha256: per-class hash of structured GitHub acquisition policy; ingress command/argument changes MUST NOT change it
canonicalization.executor_policy_sha256: hash of generated execution+maintenance action surface; ingress command/parameter changes MUST change it
canonicalization.receipt_binding: runner-instance/root receipts bind root_policy_sha256 + root_envelope_sha256 + runner_class_id; audit may additionally record overall control-plane generation

compile_steps: load and schema-validate all desired-policy inputs
resolve each execution_contract_id to resource class and semantic ceilings
resolve each resource class to exact GPU UUID claims and runtime limits
resolve project isolation identities/roots and class model/runtime bindings
verify global uniqueness of runner_class_id, scale_set_name, runner_prefix, controller Unix user
fetch/parse each trusted workflow at its declared source checkpoint
verify exact workflow blob pin and default branch
verify the job's runs-on expression is statically equal to the generated target scale-set label after migration transformation
verify route ingress parameter schema exists and has no root-authority effect
group routes by runner_class_id and prove canonical root launch projection equivalence
emit root projection, per-class controller projections, executor projection, and compatibility matrix
validate projections against their schemas and cross-digest invariants

includes: fully resolved project runner identity/root paths

deployment_overlay.purpose: Bind desired catalog generation to live installation/activation state without changing policy semantics.
deployment_overlay.rule: compiler output never starts a service or clears a quarantine; reconciliation applies a separately authorized deployment overlay

failure_rules: any workflow pin mismatch fails compilation
any route with more than one top-level job fails compilation in v1
any two classes sharing a controller Unix user fail compilation
any duplicate scale set or runner prefix fails compilation
any route grouped into non-equivalent root envelopes fails compilation
any change to immutable runner_class_id launch semantics fails compilation and requires a new class ID
any executor parameter schema that can alter root projection fails compilation
projection_independence_invariants: changing only a slash-command spelling changes control_plane_generation_sha256 and executor_policy_sha256 but not root_policy_sha256, root_envelope_sha256, or any controller_policy_sha256
changing only a workflow-local enum changes executor_policy_sha256 but not root or controller policy digests
changing a trusted workflow blob changes the relevant controller_policy_sha256 and overall generation; it does not change root envelope unless launch authority also changes
changing execution contract/resource/model/runtime/systemd/root path authority changes root envelope/policy and requires a new immutable runner_class_id
execution ingress parameter schemas may not contain infrastructure identity types or argument names implying runner class, GPU, resource, runtime, model, or profile selection
